versions.changelog:
- Initial release of skill-scaffolder for generating concise Claude Code skill skeletons.
- Enforces routing-signal three elements, five-category body taxonomy, and Faithfulness gate.
- Provides a 7-step non-interactive process to assess, draft, and structure new skills.
- File output includes only core rules in SKILL.md, with mandatory frontmatter for split files.
- Automatic anti-pattern detection and faithfulness self-check included.
- Prevents creation of skills with less than 300 tokens or when an existing solution suffices.
